learner_operation: Identify a distinct parallel line by isolating y in a given standard-form equation and matching slopes among complete line choices.

fixed_features.feature: Complete line selection after isolating y

coverage.case: Exact final five-question bands and independent 24-question controls

counterfactuals.justification: Tests dependence on given line; these pairs are not practice batches.
